source_observations.text: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

“But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

source_observations.text: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?
Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

primary_reviews.support: First-person-plural הֲלוֹא ... לְכֻלָּנוּ and מַדּוּעַ נִבְגַּד change voice and scope at 2:10; judgment ends at a pe after 2:12 before וְזֹאת שֵׁנִית in 2:13. Shared-father and creator questions frame Judah's profanation as one communal accusation, and 2:12 supplies consequence. source_observations.text: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

primary_reviews.support: 2:17 opens הוֹגַעְתֶּם ... וַאֲמַרְתֶּם and asks אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּט; 3:1 answers הִנְנִי שֹׁלֵחַ מַלְאָכִי, 3:2 tests endurance, and 3:5 returns to לַמִּשְׁפָּט as swift witness. You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

hold.question: Should Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 remain a dependent surface only when Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 parent plus Mal.3.13-Mal.3.18 sibling hydration is mechanically demonstrated, or should Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 remain only an internal seam and Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 be the sole surface?
hold.option_a: Boss treatment: surface Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 as a dependent child. Requirement: Mechanically require Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 parent plus sibling Mal.3.13-Mal.3.18 hydration on every retrieval or presentation.
hold.option_b: Canonical appeal: retain Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 only as an internal seam and surface Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 whole. Requirement: Expose the day-oracle title and internal coordinates for navigation, but never return it as a standalone chunk.
hold.preserved_disagreement: A separately surfaced Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 can be returned without its service-protest, fearers' counter-scene, and discernment cause. That makes furnace, sun/healing, trampling, group contrast, timetable, identity, or violence uses materially easier even though the literary metadata names a parent.

hold.uncertainty: The evidence does not by itself decide whether dependent retrieval with enforced hydration is safer and more useful than whole-only retrieval, and this artifact cannot verify downstream hydration enforcement.
hold.requested_next_reviewer: An independent human or external-AI reviewer with prophetic-literary and retrieval-system competence, able to inspect both the Hebrew discourse relation and actual hydration behavior.

source_observations.text: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

primary_reviews.support: After pe at MT/WLC 3:21, זִכְרוּ תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה commands remembrance; הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ begins the paired sending, and 4:6 supplies reconciliation purpose and פֶּן ... חֵרֶם risk. The coda pairs what Israel must remember with what the speaker will send before the day. Reciprocal heart-turning and the lest-clause are purpose and risk, so neither panel surfaces alone. The preceding pe and new commands distinguish the coda without granting WEB chapter authority.
counterevidence: זִכְרוּ and הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ introduce distinguishable child panels.
Named figures prompt later reuse, but reuse is not local splitting authority.
